description: Indicators (Android Indicators.kt, iOS Indicators.swift): simple moving average of the last n values and RSI after Wilder over period steps, closes oldest first. expected null = no value (too few values, n or period not positive). RSI: average loss 0 and average gain > 0 = 100; both 0 (completely flat closes) = 50. Numbers compared with a tolerance of 1e-9. Shared by IndicatorsParityTest.kt (Android) and IndicatorsParityTests.swift (iOS).

rsi.name: flat closes: no gains and no losses = 50 (neutral, not overbought)

dayCloseDescription: Closes by date (Indicators.closeOnOrBefore / changeOverDays / relativeChangePercent): series are [day, close] with day = days since 1970-01-01 (UTC), oldest first. A close 'on or before' a day may lie at most 3 days earlier; otherwise (or not positive) null. 'vs BTC' compares both series at the SAME dates: end = last day of the coin, start = end - days.

closeOnOrBefore.name: gap bridged up to three days

changeOverDays.name: missing candles do not shift the start date

relativeChange.name: coin with gaps still compares the same dates
coin series ended earlier: btc on that date
btc missing on the start date
